en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the ring when I wash. Heasws said: ‘Turn it around from its place’. And heasws said: ‘With regards to the Ablution (Wudhu), turn it around, and if you forget until you are standing in the Salaat, so Iasws do not order you that you should repeat the Salaat’.
en.sarwar: 14. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn abu al-‘Ala’ who has said the following: “I once asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the ring during taking Ghusl (bath). He (the Imam) said, ’(You must) change its place.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘You can turn the ring during Wudu’ but if you forget until you are in your Salah (prayer); I do not command you to perform your Salah (prayer) again.’”
